what_this_is: the pile tier 1 removed, ranked by how much of each contig its best protein hit explains. A cell with a count on it, never a flag and never a score

band_provenance._what: The coverage x identity cell the explained-fraction shortlist ships at, over the pile tier 1 removed.
band_provenance.the_measurement: The withheld genome's best protein hit covers 0.4624 of the contig at 66.5% identity, which lands in this cell: 69 contigs, 0.91% of the removed pile, and not one of the leak arm's 34 known contigs from the same water enters it.
band_provenance.why_that_is_said_here: The band was drawn where the one known positive sits, on a positive set of size one. It is an operating point with a provenance, not a validated threshold, and a stage that shipped it silently would be quoting a tuned cut as a property of the method. The whole joint table ships beside it so the band can be moved at output time (SPEC 13.3).
band_provenance.what_must_not_be_done_instead: Rank the removed pile by identity. Measured on the same pile: the withheld genome sits at the 93.46th percentile of removal identity, so an identity rule reaches 7,104 other contigs first. 'Flag the low-identity removals' is dead and measured.
band_provenance.ordering_within_the_cell_is_open: The candidate ranks 4th by bitscore inside its own cell at nucleotide level and 2nd at protein, so the defensible output is the cell with a count on it, never a flag and never the top row.

null_citations.shuffled_contigs_with_a_significant_hit: 0 of 22,110 (results/holdout_cascade/) and 0 of 11,361 on Berlin (results/crossplant/ shuffle arm, corrected null)
null_citations.why_it_is_a_citation_and_not_this_run_s_: This stage reads search output the cascade already wrote; it runs no search of its own, so it cannot produce a null. Pass --shuffled-evidence to supply one, or --without-null to record its absence by name.

pile.a_contig_is_scored_when: it has a protein-route row with an E-value below 1e-05 and a recorded query coverage

band.ordering_note: The candidate ranks 4th by bitscore inside its own cell at nucleotide level and 2nd at protein, so the defensible output is the cell with a count on it, never a flag and never the top row.

control_arm.what_it_is: removals at or above 97.0% identity: near-reference material from this same library, the arm that says which cells known sequence occupies
control_arm.direction_measured_on_known_material: On the holdout library's 34 leak contigs - known sequence from the same water - not one sits below 80% identity at either level and none enters the band. So crowding inside the band is other background, not recognisable material (results/holdout_cascade/).
